senses.gloss: m. (עָמַל; v. עֲמֵילָה) well-worked dough; עֲמִילָן של טבחים dough which cooks use to place over the pot.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 3:1">Pes. III, 1</cite>, defined <cite ref="Pesachim 42b:15">ib. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>פת תבואה וכ׳</he> bread made of grain not yet one-third ripe, which is put over the pot to absorb the froth; Y. ib. III, 29ᵈ <he>מביא מלילות וכ׳</he> one takes ears not yet one-third full &c.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 86b:2">B. Mets. 86ᵇ</cite> <he>הללו לע׳ של ט׳</he> (these quantities of flour) were used for the cooks’ dough only.—[Ἄμυλον, which is referred to by Mus. to Ar., corresponds to our word neither in form nor in meaning (v. Sachs Beitr. I, 148), besides this etymology is contradicted by <he>פת עֲמֵילָה</he>.]
